reply_text:
Bettina, I can't set up a recurring Monday 08:00 post. I have no scheduler that posts into Slack channels, and a Hermes cron job here only saves its output locally, so it wouldn't land in #coastal-team.

I can do it by hand each week. Ask me in this channel on a Monday and I'll post the digest from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, covering the previous week plus open customer items. If you want a reminder on the calendar in the meantime, I can create one for Mondays at 08:00, though it won't post the digest for you.
